USAGE:
    sem [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

EXAMPLES:
    sem monitor
    sem monitor --tenant contoso --detailed
    sem tenant add xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx Contoso
    sem tenant remove Contoso
    sem config set --threshold 60

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help       Prints help information   
    -v, --version    Prints version information

COMMANDS:
    monitor    Check expiring secrets across configured tenants
    tenant     Manage monitored tenants                        
    config     View or update tool configuration

result.stdout:
DESCRIPTION:
Check expiring secrets across configured tenants.

USAGE:
    sem monitor [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    sem monitor
    sem monitor --tenant contoso --detailed

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help                   Prints help information                        
    -v, --version                Prints version information                     
    -t, --tenant <NAME_OR_ID>    Only monitor this tenant (name or ID). Defaults
                                 to all configured tenants                      
        --threshold <DAYS>       Override the configured days threshold for this
                                 run                                            
    -d, --detailed               Show a summary breakdown after the table
